title: Twisted modules of $\frac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}$-graded modular vertex superalgebras
summary: In this paper, we investigate the theory of $g$-twisted modules for modular $\frac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}$-graded vertex superalgebras over an algebraically closed field $\mathbb{F}$ of prime characteristic $p>2$. For a $\frac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}$-graded vertex superalgebra $V$ and an automorphism $g$ of $V$ of finite order $T$ relatively prime to $p$, we give a twisted version of Zhu's associative algebra, denoted by $A_g(V)$.
